topic: Git worktree isolation for parallel Claude sessions

claims.claim: Claude Code integrates git worktrees for isolated parallel sessions: each worktree lives at .claude/worktrees/<name>/ with its own branch based on HEAD.
EnterWorktree tool creates a worktree + branch and switches the session's cwd to it; ExitWorktree returns with keep-or-remove choice.
Worktrees require a git repository OR WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks for VCS-agnostic isolation (non-git projects can plug in custom isolation).
CRITICAL BUG #38287: silent commit deletion can occur when Claude Code's worktree cleanup intersects with user-initiated git operations; work can be lost without warning.
Windows caveats: symlinks require admin or developer mode; git on Windows uses junctions/symlinks for worktrees, which can fail or behave inconsistently on NTFS.
Worktrees share the same .git object database (not independent clones) - object reads are cheap, but concurrent writes to refs/packs can cause contention.
Each worktree has independent: HEAD, index, working tree, reflog for its branch. But shares: objects, config, hooks dir (unless configured per-worktree), remote.
Worktree cleanup via ExitWorktree with action: 'remove' deletes the working directory but preserves the branch (unless also branch is force-deleted).
Entering an existing worktree via path parameter requires that path to appear in git worktree list for the current repo - unregistered paths are rejected.
Running multiple Claude Code sessions against the same repo without worktree isolation leads to merge conflicts, branch thrash, and stash chaos.
Worktrees are most useful for Agent Teams teammates (R6) and for user-driven parallel sessions where each agent owns a different feature branch.
CLAUDE.md is resolved from the worktree's cwd, so project-level instructions apply identically across worktrees of the same repo.
Should be used ONLY when explicitly instructed (via user or CLAUDE.md); EnterWorktree tool intentionally requires explicit opt-in to avoid accidental branch proliferation.
WorktreeCreate hook CAN block creation (exit code 2 + prints worktree path to stdout); WorktreeRemove CANNOT block.
Name segment rules: each /-separated segment max 64 chars, letters/digits/dots/underscores/dashes only; random name generated if not provided.

conflicts_flagged.description: Community guides suggest using worktrees for ALL parallel work; Anthropic docs and tool description caution against default use due to branch sprawl and cleanup burden.
conflicts_flagged.resolution_hint: Use worktrees for long-lived parallel features; use subagents or Agent Teams in-process for short exploration.

gaps_flagged.description: Exact mechanism of Issue #38287 silent commit deletion not fully documented - root cause analysis missing.
Windows support status unclear for split-pane Agent Teams + worktrees combined use.
No official guidance on max concurrent worktrees; performance implications unquantified.
